issue.description:
AGENTS.md requires every mutating operation to be atomic, auditable, and concurrency-tested, and ADR-003's dirtiness contract says every committed semantic mutation advances the live event sequence. Open beads restore audit events for create (beadrs-23fea176), dependency mutations (beadrs-633ff22e), external references (beadrs-4ba1412e), and structured data (beadrs-857f897d), and comment mutations landed their audit events with R010 — but no bead covers `bead label add|remove`. Add a label-mutation audit event, ensure it advances the event sequence so automatic checkpoint publication reflects the change, and add tests asserting the events round-trip through the published checkpoint.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Emit audit events for label add/remove mutations

issue.description:
ADR-005 records the drawback that there is no way to mark an assignment as intentionally parked, so a legitimate reservation triggers the ready_frontier warning on every doctor run — the classic path to the warning losing its meaning. Work: design a deliberate-reservation marker settable only by an explicit operator command, exempt flagged issues from the ADR-005 doctor warning while keeping them excluded from the ready frontier and unclaimable, surface the flag in list/show, carry it through checkpoint round trips (and redaction's rewritten events), and test that flagging never makes an issue claimable.
